rationale: Matches the CLI's actual default loops dir (config/features.py, cli/loop/__init__.py) so promoted drafts are discoverable via ll-loop list/run. Deliberately widens the FEAT-3335 promote-window containment gate's allowed realpaths (allow_loops_dir) from an isolated .ll/loops dir to the whole .loops tree (project loops, runs/, .history/). Accepted: promote's collision suffixing prevents overwrites, and the gate still excludes everything outside .loops. Accepted debt: still mismatches projects overriding loops.loops_dir in .ll/ll-config.json; deferred as a follow-up.
rule: workflow-generator promote's context.loops_dir default changed from .ll/loops to .loops
